description: Verify a business TIN/EIN against IRS records — confirms a 9-digit EIN matches the legal business name on file with the IRS. Returns match status, IRS code/reason and last-checked date. Synchronous (<5s). Example: cobalt_tin_verify({ tin: "123456789", businessName: "Acme Corp", _apiKey: "your-key" })

businessName.description: The legal business name exactly as filed with the IRS.

tin.description: The 9-digit EIN/TIN, digits only (no dashes), e.g. "123456789".

name: cobalt_tin_verify
title: Cobalt Tin Verify
